scenario.goal: Book a technician appointment for 30 October 2026 at 10 AM India time. State this exact calendar date rather than tomorrow. Supply Sravani, Madhapur, window AC general servicing, sravani.audit@example.invalid and your fictional number +12025550149 if asked. Request a 30 minute calendar appointment, explicitly approve creating it and ask for confirmation from the calendar. You are not requesting a phone call or permanent blocking. If they suggest a callback, state positively that you want the calendar appointment. End after confirmation or two truthful limitations.

agent.name: SmartCare Appliance Services
agent.brief:
Need helpful support agent Suresh for SmartCare Appliance Services.
Phone customer support and booking inquiries in Telugu.
Hyderabad home appliance repair and maintenance services.
AC servicing: basic Window AC servicing 499 rupees, Split AC servicing 599 rupees.
Fridge inspection charge 250 rupees; if repair is done by technician, inspection charge is completely waived.
Replacement parts are extra at actual MRP and technician quotes after inspection; no fixed parts quotes over phone.
Working days: Monday to Sunday 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
Service areas: Hyderabad West - Madhapur, Gachibowli, Kondapur, Kukatpally.
Secunderabad and Old City areas are currently not covered.
Slots: Next-day visit slots between 10 AM and 6 PM. Same-day emergency service not guaranteed.
Goal: answer service pricing and area questions honestly.
If customer requests appointment, take caller name, appliance type, issue, locality and preferred slot.
Never advise customer to open electrical panels or live wiring themselves.
Do not sell AMC contracts or courses. Caller declining AC may still need fridge service.
Language: te-IN.

facts.permitted_next_steps: Check locality and appliance issue; collect name, phone, address and preferred slot (10 AM - 6 PM next day) to book or request technician visit.
facts.service_areas: Hyderabad West only: Madhapur, Gachibowli, Kondapur, Kukatpally. Secunderabad and Old City are not serviced.
facts.pricing_terms: Split AC 599 rupees, Window AC 499 rupees. Fridge inspection 250 rupees (waived if repair accepted). Spare parts extra at actuals.
facts.safety_rules: Never advise live electrical inspection. Tell customer to unplug faulty appliances and wait for certified technician.
facts.forbidden_actions: Do not promise same-day visit or quote parts prices before technician inspection. No advance payment on call.

outcome.summary_en: The caller requested general servicing for an AC and initially asked for a 30-minute technician appointment on 30 October 2026 at 10:00 AM India time. The agent offered 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM slots and requested the caller's name. The caller selected 10:00 AM, provided the name Shravani, locality Madhapur, email sravani.audit@example.invalid, and phone number +12025550149, and clarified that the appliance was a window AC. The agent stated that a 10:00–10:30 AM appointment was confirmed, but incorrectly referred to split AC servicing and quoted ₹599. The caller raised the appliance and pricing discrepancy and asked for the appointment details to be sent by email. The agent corrected the service type and quoted ₹499 for window AC general servicing, stating that the appointment details had been emailed. The caller accepted the ₹499 price and repeatedly requested final confirmation. The agent again confirmed that the appointment was recorded and confirmed. The caller ended by confirming the 30 October 2026 10:00 AM India-time window AC appointment and explicitly said no callback was needed; the call ended courteously.
outcome.next_action: Do not contact this number. The caller opted out.
objections: The agent initially identified the appliance as split AC instead of window AC.
The agent initially quoted ₹599 instead of the corrected ₹499 window AC service price.
outcome.notes: The agent claimed the appointment details were emailed, but the transcript does not independently verify delivery. The caller explicitly declined any further callback.
